abstract.t: This document specifies how a QUIC endpoint may delegate the emission of Stateless Resets to a component that outlives the QUIC stack -- for example, an operating system that resets the peers of an application that has exited. As such delegation is most useful on the client side, where endpoints often use zero-length Connection IDs, this document also defines a transport parameter and a frame that allow those clients to advertise a Stateless Reset Token.
